features: 30W Wooden Cabinet Home Theater with Punchy Bass Experience powerful 30W output from an 8mm solid wooden cabinet housing a 4-inch woofer for deep bass and 3-inch mid-range driver for crystal-clear vocals. Designed for 75-125 sq. ft. rooms, this system delivers theater-like sound with zero distortion. The multi-function remote make it user-friendly, while supporting Bluetooth/USB/FM/AUX/mic inputs – perfect for movies, music!

All-in-One Entertainment Hub with Digital Display Enjoy seamless connectivity via Bluetooth 5.0 (for TVs/phones), USB/SD playback, FM radio, and AUX input. The built-in mic port transforms it into a karaoke machine (mic not included). Unique top-mounted mobile stand lets you watch movies hands-free, while the digital display shows modes/volume for hassle-free control. A complete plug-and-play home theater!

"Lata-Rafi" Portable Karaoke Speaker – Unleash Your Inner Singer Named after legendary singers, this speaker ignites your passion for music with studio-grade sound clarity. Insert any dynamic mic (sold separately) and host outdoor singing sessions, family gatherings, or parties. The 30W RMS power ensures your voice shines with balanced bass and highs, making it a must-have for aspiring performers!

"Madhell by Tronica" – Audiophile-Grade Sound That Drives You Crazy! As the name suggests, this speaker will make you "Yamla Pagla Deewana" (madly passionate) with its unmatched audio performance. Compare it to any speaker in its range – the wooden cabinet acoustics, precise drivers, and zero distortion will shock you! Ideal for music lovers who crave rich, detailed sound without breaking the bank.

Smart TV Companion with Mobile Stand & Easy Bluetooth Pairing The innovative phone stand on top lets you place your smartphone/tablet to watch movies or YouTube. Effortlessly pair with smart TVs via Bluetooth for wireless surround sound. Compact yet powerful, it’s perfect for small apartments, bedrooms, or outdoor movie nights – redefining portable home entertainment!
